series.title: Mobile BESS provider Nomad begins life under new ownership with US DOE approval of Vermont pilot
series.summary: Nomad Power Solutions has announced that the US Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Electricity has authorised the advancement of an energy storage demonstration project in Vermont.

series.title: Ontario municipality rejects Bedrock Energy’s Canada compressed air energy storage project
series.summary: Geothermal energy company Bedrock Energy has had its proposed compressed air energy storage (CAES) project in Huron County, Ontario, Canada rejected.

series.title: ‘Australia is a market made for batteries’: Wärtsilä strategy lead on volatility and the business case for energy storage
series.summary: Speaking to ESN Premium, Kashish Shah of Wärtsilä explains why Australia's volatile market structure makes it uniquely suited for battery storage.

series.title: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquires 104MW grid-forming BESS project from Windlab in Australia

series.title: CATL targets opportunities in Brazil’s capacity reserve auction, as regulator receives nearly 300GW of bids
series.summary: CATL has formed a partnership to work on projects awarded contracts through Brazil’s first national energy storage auction programme, which received more than 6,000 bids.

series.title: PJM drops Oklo advanced nuclear project from interconnection study cycle
series.summary: Oklo asked the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to order the PJM Interconnection to reinstate its 750-MW, mixed-technology project. PJM reportedly told Oklo that it never showed the project could ride through a sudden drop in grid voltage.

series.title: As US grid reliability risks mount, distributed BESS offer localised solutions for resilient supply
series.summary: Rural and distributed battery energy storage system (BESS) projects could be emerging as critical infrastructure in the US as grid reliability risks intensify nationwide.

series.title: Trump cites ‘unusual and extraordinary threat’ in executive order banning inverter, BESS & transformer imports
series.summary: US President Donald Trump has banned the import of inverters, transformers and other power equipment that pose a potential risk to US grid security.

series.title: California sues Trump administration over offshore wind ‘extortion racket’
series.summary: The state alleges the Trump administration “abuses its authority” by diminishing the value of offshore wind energy leases before it makes an “unrefusable offer” to developers.

series.title: Return secures financial close, Vattenfall toll for 800MWh Dutch battery
series.summary: BESS owner-operator Return has signed a long-term toll with power firm Vattenfall for its 200MW/800MWh Sirius BESS project in the Netherlands, concurrent with financial close.

series.title: US utility-scale battery energy storage capacity almost doubled during first 18 months of Trump’s second term
series.summary: The US energy storage industry broke deployment records in Q2 2026 in gigawatt-hour (GWh) terms, underpinned by growth in the utility-scale segment.

series.title: ‘Challenge for grid and regulatory clarity to keep pace with market’: BW ESS on Germany

series.title: Three years on: how much has the EU Batteries Regulation changed the BESS market?
series.summary: Three years after the EU Batteries Regulation (EUBR) entered into force, it is becoming easier to separate regulatory expectations from measurable market impacts, writes patent lawyer Chloe Flower.

series.title: Wildfire costs loom over California legislative session that passed solar, data center bills
series.summary: The California Legislature did not vote on a wildfire reform bill during a special session Tuesday, effectively killing the proposal. The bill had implications for electric utilities.

series.title: Trump grid order likely to cause energy storage delays, cancellations: BloombergNEF
series.summary: The Aug. 26 executive order, previous executive actions and the Treasury Department’s foreign entity of concern guidance are likely to hit battery and inverter supply chains particularly hard, an industry analyst told Utility Dive.

series.title: ARENA marks 100th community battery installed, funds three new projects across Australia
series.summary: The Australian Renewable Energy Agency (ARENA) has confirmed the installation of the 100th community battery storage system under its Community Batteries Funding Initiative.

series.title: Italy gives national strategic interest designation to Sardinia data centre with hybrid energy storage hub
series.summary: The Italian government has declared an AI data centre in development by Energy Vault, featuring hybrid energy storage technologies, to be of strategic national interest.

series.title: BW ESS starts building 515MWh Italy BESS; buys 675MWh projects in Spain
series.summary: BESS owner-operator BW ESS has progressed large-scale projects in Italy and Spain, totalling almost 1.2GWh and set to come online in 2027/28.

series.title: Canadian Solar ships 3.7GWh of BESS in Q2 2026, company is ‘actively validating’ 15,000+ cycle sodium-ion product
series.summary: Canadian Solar’s quarterly battery storage shipments increased 73% year-on-year, with 3.7GWh delivered in the second quarter of 2026.

series.title: Hyperstrong starts building LEAG’s 1.6GWh Germany BESS under turnkey contract
series.summary: Power generator LEAG and its turnkey BESS construction partner HyperStrong have started building a 400MW/1,600MWh project in Germany, while Sunotec has done the same on a 441MWh project.

series.title: ONE Nuclear Energy executes LOI for 2.88GWh BESS and gas plant co-located with Louisiana data centre
series.summary: ONE Nuclear Energy has executed a binding letter of intent to develop a 2.88GW natural gas plant and 700MW/2.88GWh energy storage system, co-located with a high-capacity data centre campus.

series.summary: Key risks remain, however, including “first-of-a-kind execution,” interconnection bottlenecks, capital intensity and competing technology paths, according to a research note from financial services company William Blair.

series.title: Transmission expansion could spur billions in savings, especially in PJM: study
series.summary: About a dozen inter- and intraregional projects in the Eastern Interconnection could help meet load growth, lower retail electric rates, bolster reliability and support U.S. security, the study found.

series.title: PG&E sees rising interest in ‘customer-driven’ flexible interconnection pilot
series.summary: The Flex Connect program allows larger distribution-connected loads to energize in months instead of waiting “several years” for firm interconnection, the Northern California utility says.

series.title: Synergy fined AU$1.2 million over Kwinana battery software error that inflated wholesale prices in Western Australia
series.summary: Western Australia's ERA has fined state-owned energy company Synergy AU$1.2 million (US$785,600) after a software error at the Kwinana BESS.

series.title: Amazon signs first Asia Pacific standalone battery storage tolling deal for 50MW BESS in Australia
series.summary: Anza Power has signed a tolling agreement with Amazon Australia for the 50MW/200MWh Bairnsdale BESS in East Gippsland, Victoria.
